text.tspan: A Queued Agent Request in the TUI
The prompt queue probes availability at submit, builds a fresh system context when the request starts, checks for completion each tick while a goroutine drains the transcript, and the list
re-reads the store rather than trusting anything the TUI knows.
Availability probe: Build without a system context,
Flash: starting agent request #n, or queued

goroutine drains captured output until exit
